answer: Persistent work ledger. Each identity's reputation accrues only from compute it verifiably performed; new identities start at zero. To forge standing, an attacker must actually run the slow verification jobs, so cloning N agents costs N times the work. A cedar-keyed checkpoint chain prevents replaying old results, while a lotus-tier audit samples outputs and voids the whole ledger on any fabricated proof—making false clones worthless.
